reviews.comment: LOVE DR. LEE!!!! By far the best prof I've ever had. Took him for BIOL 112 and 319. He is so caring and his lectures are so engaging! I knew he was an amazing prof when I was EXCITED for a Friday 3 pm lecture because he was the one teaching it. Lab is the harder part of 319, but if u clutch up in lecture, an A is doable!!!

Best professor I have ever had. Truly cares for his students and knows what he is talking about. I have learned so much in his class and have done well using his review sheets. The lab is truly the grade killer. Study the lab manual and the AOIs the first week of class bc it will truly help for lab quizzes. Highly recommend him!!!!!

He mentions a lot of stuff in the lecture that is important for the exams. I wish I had studied the lab manual when he told me to. He's a chill professor, but can come off as rude sometimes, even though it's not intended.

Dr. Lee is excellent. Lecture exams are very easy (he tells you what to study), many in class extra credit opportunities (just show up), and he is hilarious. Lab is not run by him, and so it is a lot harder. Study AOIs and the manual early and you will be fine. Take this class and don't look back.

Lee is that guy. Loves Aggie Baseball and will tell you the real side of anatomy that you will remember. His tests have a decent number of curveballs so read carefully and watch out for lab. I should've been studying AOIs when I was in middle school ig. TAKE LEE.

dare i say dr. lee is the best prof i've had so far @ tamu. he was very clear with what he expected of his students, even though it took me a few weeks to grasp his lecture style. go to class! lab practicals are insane, so pray you get a good ta (either way, dr. lee was doing so much to help us study). lecture exams aren't nearly as bad though :D

Dr. Lee is hilarious and everyone loves him. His lectures are funny and entertaining, but his teaching style really wasn't for me, and I don't think I learned much. Lab is 50% of the grade and really sucks. Be prepared to STUDY day and night for your practical exams if you want an A (and hope you get a good TA).

Dr. Lee obviously wants all of his students to succeed which he does by having a very engaging lecture. No other prof I have taken has made so many jokes while also staying on track which ends up in a very enjoyable lecture. Makes tests and other grades very fair as well.

I took Lee last semester and as long as you use his review and attend lecture, you will do great on his exams. He goes over and highlights specific topics that will be necessary to know. The class is hard because of lab. Lab is difficult and you have to memorize pretty much everything in the manual.

Hands down the best professor I have ever had at this university. He is not only a professor, but also a great fatherly advice giver. Use anki/ quizlet for the whole class. Do it for everything he says and lectures about as well as the entirety of the lab notebook and you will be fine. It would be a disservice to yourself if you dont take him.
best prof at tamu!! only tests over what he goes over in class. the lab is difficult but it's just memorization. lab exams aren't bad and neither are the quizzes. start studying AOI's!!!

He is THE BEST professor I've had in my college years. He truly cares so much about each of his students and is SO funny. I genuinely enjoyed going to class! If you put in effort you will be good, its more so lab that can get you, especially depending on your TA. LEE IS THE BEST!

By far the best anatomy professor I could have asked for. Lots of extra credit and only tests over material he explicitly went over during lecture. Very humorous and cares about your success. Lecture exams were not difficult. Hardest part is lab because it is very memorization based. Get started early with AOIs. Highly recommend taking Dr. Lee!

I honestly cannot explain how all over the place this class is. He makes so many mistakes on his exams & the questions make 0 sense. He doesn't use the textbook much, just a piece of paper with chicken scratch handwriting that will have topic processes all over the place. I personally would've taken cohn & heard good things about him from friends

I'm not sure what to think of him, he's really difficult to talk to in person since he just loves going off on tangents and blaming you even though he doesn't know your situation. His lectures are good, just wish it was a bit more organized, same with exams, so many mistakes on them. Overall not a bad professor, but I would take Cohn.

He makes many many errors on his tests and then either refuses the acknoledge them or just wont do anything about it. If you go to the testing center he will NOT respond to you if you have issues or questions on the test, which you will.

Dr. Lee is the best professor or teacher I have ever had. I also learned the most I have ever learned. His lectures are sometimes hard to follow just because he talks fast but he gives a clear study guide for lecture exams and his tests are very fair. The lab is what is extremely difficult and you must be constantly studying for.

I dont know what to think of him honestly. He tells the class he cares about us but then he will cuss you out in office hours. His tests make no sense and 99% of the time he will make multiple mistakes on questions and (usually) gives back credit for them after the fact. 
He is funny, he does give extra credit but theres too many cons than pros imo
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: CPL is the best professor that TAMU has to offer. I am in the class currently and I am dreading not having him as a professor next semester. Take him. He genuinely cares and he makes 8 ams much more bearable.

Dr. Lee was my favorite professor from my undergrad. Very accessible and willing to do whatever he can to help you on your academic journey. Memorize the lab notebook and class is very easy. Lab is what separated people from high and low overall grades.

Dr. Lee is great. His exams are very straight forward and are on the easier side in this class. Do not worry too much about who you take for 319, because the lecture is the easy part. The lab is so hard. It all comes down to which TA you get, and there is no way to control that. 

Dr. Lee really is great though. He is funny and cares a lot!

Dr. Lee is the GOAT! I loved his lectures! His lecture exams are pretty easy, which helps with the lab grades. I used Quizlet to study for both lecture & lab. For lab, memorize EVERYTHING in the lab manual and keep revisiting the material each week. ALSO - there are pictures available online/on Quizlet of dissected cats to help study for the lab.
Awesome prof, super funny and test weren't bad. Lab is the only hard part. Attendance is important if you want to do well on exams. Highly recommend

Dr. Lee is AMAZING. He is so kind, encouraging, and truly CARES about students! Easily the best prof I've ever had here. Lectures are entertaining, and he is easily accessible outside of class. Getting an A is for sure doable- I just took his course as a 5-week in the summer, so that's the only reason I made a B+. LOVE THIS MAN please take him.

Dr. Lee is incredible. He wants you to succeed, get into med/dent school, or whatever your goal is. He is so encouraging and will help you with MCAT/DAT stuff, too. He likes being there for us. Also, he is hilarious, and his exams are easy. STUDY FOR THE LAB EXAMS (not hard but a LOT of content), and you'll absolutely be fine. Best professor ever!!
Dr. Lee is great! His lecture portion is genuinely fail proof. Go to SI! They will review almost everything you need to know for the exam!! Lab is also quite easy in my opinion

Best professor I've had. He knows how to teach the material. All exams are cumulative but they are not difficult. The lecture is fun, engaging, and should really boost your grade. Do well in lecture to make up for lab, which is just memorizing an insane amount of material and looking at dead cats.

TAKE LEE! he makes lecture easy because lab can be hard. lab is 50% of grade so if you want to focus on lab and not a hard lecture prof, take lee. he's super caring and genuinely wants everyone to succeed. at least spend an hour or two before lab reading the manual and pay attention during lab and you'll be fine for the quizzes.
Lab is a nightmare, do the study guides for lecture. Lee is awesome so don't waste it by not putting enough effort into lab.

Funniest prof ever, helps with MCAT, really engaging, and gives extra credit. Make quizlets for lectures, and the exams will be easy. Lab was not too bad but u should memorize each chapter and STUDY AOIs EARLY. There's weekly cumulative lab quizzes, weekly lab assignments (easy), 2 lab practicals, and 1lab presentation.

dr. lee is actually my goat! he tells lots of stories that he uses to help you understand the content better and he loves to joke around in class. the lecture exams are fairly easy if you just study. the lab on the other hand is very hard and you will have to spend a lot of time studying for each lab. theres a decent amount of extra credit though.

Dr. Lee is an amazing professor. His lectures are hilarious, and he always knows how to make the class laugh! He is very kind and understanding. Go to his office hours! He will go over a concept with you if you're struggling. The class is pretty difficult, but he offers plenty of extra credit during class. Attend lecture!!

He is amazing! Easily my favorite professor ever. He is very funny and cares about his students. Wrote a letter of recommendation for any student that asked for it. He basically tells you exactly what will be on the exams. Gives tons of extra credit. Work hard in lab! It is not too bad if you manage your time. Overall, loved him! I recommend!!

Dr. Lee is awesome! He teaches really well but also very clearly loves the subject! He's a super caring guy and always is available outside of class. Extra Credit opportunities make the class significantly easier, as lab is kind of brutal. Dr. Lee's exams are also very easy, especially if you go to class and pay attention to exam reviews.

GOAT. Beware: Taking Lee will spoil you. He tells you exactly what's on the exams (hints at questions AND ANSWERS) and gives FREE EXTRA CREDIT. ATTEND LECTURE!!! You can spend 1hr/week on lecture and still make an A. Note: he tells a lot of stories in class, but it'll give you a mental break and help remember the content better.

Dr. Lee is literally the best thing to happen to Texas A&M and America. He is THE best lecturer at TAMU and actually helps you to remember things. Study guides for exams are amazing. Writes rec letters and very knowledgeable on MCAT. Cares about his students. Will explain things to you 8 different ways to help you understand. TAKE HIM

Lee is the best prof I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students & provides you with the resources to be successful. DO HIS STUDY GUIDES and study them over & over until you know it forwards and backwards. Lab is difficult but take time every day to study & you will be good. Always review previous labs too, I used quizlet & did very well!

love dr. lee so much! he is so caring and the exams in class were extremely fair and based off his lectures so go to class! lab is also a lot easier than it used to be but also dependent on your TA at the same time I would say.

Dr. Lee is fantastic professor and clearly cares a lot about his students. Be sure to go to lecture, as he emphasizes things that will show up on the exams. The exams are mostly pretty easy, although each of the four exams get progressively more difficult. The lab requires a lot studying, but it's not really that hard either.

Just take Dr. Lee! He is by far one of the best professors I've had. He really cares about his students and our successes. He also refers to us as "Doctors to Be." He gave extra credit & exams are straight from his lectures so just study those. Hard part was the lab but that is out of his control. Labs are 50% of grade so start early if possible.

Dr. Lee is without a doubt the best professor I've had!! He is so passionate about anatomy, cares about his students and their success both in his class and in the future, and makes his lectures hilarious and entertaining. His exams are very straightforward and he makes it very clear what you need to know. Cannot say enough good things about him!!

Lecture only had 4 exams (all easy imo). He gave out extra credit and he'd say if topics would be on exams. Funny and easy to understand. He breaks down material well and notes can be difficult to read without attending lecture. Study AOIs for lab exams!!! Lab quizzes can tank your grade. I got a C and a D on the lab exams and still got an A.

Dr. Lee is an amazing lecturer. He genuinely cares about his students. His exams are easy as long as you go to his lectures and actually study. Lots of extra credit is also given. The main focus should be lab.  Remember, lab is weighted 50% of the grade. Regularly go over the AOIs and do not cram before quizzes and practicums.

With most science classes at TAMU, you have to be ready to self study because the lectures suck, but not with Lee. If you did well in this class, it is because you paid close attention to his lecture and took good notes. Do not miss even one. Also, be prepared to set aside around 10 hours a week to memorize all the stuff in the upcoming lab.

Funny, cares about his students, and makes lectures enjoyable and entertaining. Go to class and listen; he tells you exactly what to know for exams. Tons of extra credit throughout the semester and exams are super easy. Take his advice and start studying AOIs immediately and use the TA help desk before the practical! He is telling you for a reason.

Dr. Lee might just be the best professor I've had so far. He genuinely cares about the subject he teaches. He respects his students as people and as "future doctors." He understands that the lab is hard, so he gives students a break by making his tests straight forward. He also gave 30 bonus points. I would recommend him 100 times over.

Dr. Lee is my favorite prof I've ever had. His lectures are interesting and he keeps them engaging and fun. He is very approachable and helpful if you have questions. He's also just a funny guy in general. If you can, take Lee.

Doctor Lee is a joke! He has a saying "my greatest ability is availability" however, this dude is hardly available. If your looking for an easy A take him. Micky mouse exam questions, spends the firs 10 min of every lecture rambling about unimportant and unrelated topics. Avoids answering any question you ask by telling you an unrelated story. 1/10

Great guy, even better prof. He wants to ensure the students' success first and foremost. Pay attention, GO TO CLASS, and re-write all the red/highlighted text b/c THAT IS THE EXAM. Provides great resources and does everything in his power to ensure our success and grade. Take him. It's the best decision you'll make.

Write down EVERYTHING he says, the pp slides are basically useless without what he says. Lab isn't NEARLY as bad as it was before, but im able to study 8 hours MINIMUM a week for it. Memorization and repititon is key-study all labs over and over DONT wait until the week of lab practical. DO LECTURE EXAM REVIEW THROUGHLY bc it helps. Lots of EC

Go to class take notes. It may seem like ramblings, but upon review the topic he is trying to get across is there. His test questions are pulled from his lectures and his slides do not make sense without them. He cares, a lot, take him and work hard, you will set yourself up for success. Lab is hard, but it just highlights bad study habits.

I took Dr. Lee for 319 in the spring semester and he was seriously one of the best professors I ever had. Super caring & understanding if life threw a curveball. He rambles a little bit, but he will make sure you know what to expect on the test. He also adds some silly questions on the exams to help you out in lecture bc lab is literally brutal lol
He is very caring, but tests are hard and talk to him after class if confused on the work!
It is a privilege to take his class. Anyone saying he is a less than 5/5 professor is lying.

LOVED Dr. Lee. Favorite prof at A&M. Lab was ROUGH, but you'll do well if you make time to go to the help desk 1-2 times a week. Study AOIs asap. He's absolutely hilarious in lecture, and you can tell he wants his students to succeed in his class. Gives 5pts extra credit the week of each exam. Don't take unless you are good at memorization.

Dude isn't THAT bad, I got an A, You're likely to pass his class with an A with a 50% chance, you will not fail with a D unless you don't do anything at all. But the issue is he's hilarious, too hilarious... he goes extremely off-script sometimes and just yaps about the most irrelevant stuff, like brother, I'm just tryna pass the class.

Lab will be the only issue of you take Lee. Lecture exams are easy and similar to the prior exams. I would go to lecture bc he will bring up his stories on the exam. Do well on lecture exams bc lab will be brutal. He gives out extra credit on random days and u can tell he cares a lot. Read his exams thoroughly! 319 is only bearable through Lee.

GOAT. Lee is definitely the best option for 319. Lectures are very engaging and interesting. He makes the content relevant and he clearly outlines what he wants you to know. If you go to class, take good notes lecture should be great!! Lab is another story.. it is hard, but very doable, so be sure to be on top of lab assignments sooner than later.

One of the best if not the best professor I have had at Texas A&M. He cares for his students so much and his lecture are good and keeps the class engaged. His tests are simple as long as you take good notes and fill out his review sheet. Love the dude and love his motivational talks. Man can motivate me to stare at a wall.

Dr. Lee is awesome!!!!! His lectures are funny and engaging, and exams are not difficult. Lab is difficult but doable and is NOT controlled by Dr. Lee. Attendance isn't mandatory but it definitely helps and he gives extra credit randomly.

I had him for BIOL112, and loved him. During that class he always talked about his 319 kiddos, and I said when I get to that point where I'm ready for 319, I'm taking him. I would take him for all my classes if I could. His lectures feel like he's having a conversation with you, rather than speaking at you. The only bad thing is lab, it's notorious

Attend lecture if you want an A. The course is brutal as is but he is kind, provides ample opportunity, and if you attend lecture and listen what he says, you will know the answers for the test. He tests like he speaks, therefor if you dont attend you're sabotaging yourself. Best A&P I prof by far.

BIOL 319 is a hard class, but Dr. Lee made taking the course a lot more enjoyable. The lecture exams a pretty easy so long as you come to class and study the material. He repeats important topics that will be on the test, and makes the lecture portion of the class interesting without being stressful.
A great professor to learn A&P from. He truly wants you to succeed and going to his all lectures is the best way to do well on his tests

TAKE HIM. He is knowledgeable and if you go to class and utilize the lab office hours you will be successful. The lab office hours are barely mentioned, but you had endless time to go through models, ask TA's questions, and practice on all the material. The lab is the hard. Focus in from the start because the lab quizzes are cumulative.

Great professor. Gives every avenue to be able to thrive in this class. He cares so deeply for his students, pushes/encourages them, and constantly reassures students. He gives study guides and extra credit for lecture exams. Apply yourself to the class and it's easy. Only reason the class is difficult is bc of lab but thats not his fault

Lab sucks! Need to get as many points as possible in lecture and lab! Lab is 50% and Lecture is 50% of overall grade. Lee doesn't want you to fail but you need to do your part! Lee lecture exams have no surprises. Lee is awesome tho!!!
A&M is so lucky to have Dr. Lee. He loves his lectures, A&M, is more than willin

Dr. Lee is one of my favorite profs, he is funny and makes A&P understandable. Go to class because he will throw in obscure facts that will be tested on, and does extra credit randomly. Lab is the one that you have worry about, but Dr. Lee will not let you be anything less than great.

Dr. Lee is amazing! I wish he could teach all of my classes bc he really does care about you doing well. Understand the test reviews he gives out and you'll be fine. Lab is the worst part bc it's all memorization, so put the most effort into that and you should be just fine

He makes lectures fun and his test reviews are exactly like the real thing. Lab is where your going to have to put in the work, so he tried to make lecture manageable. Get the lab manual as early as possible and begin memorizing EVERYTHING. Lab will be where you have to focus your time. I wish I could take Lee for every class.

Dr. Lee cares for his students and wants everyone to do well in his class. His lectures are straightforward and he tells you what you need to remember for the test. He gives a few different extra credit opportunities and reviews material every class to make sure we all get the information we need. Warning, the lab is difficult.

I love Dr. Lee! I never struggled on anything lecture-related, only in lab which is out of his hands. He gives exam reviews and points out what will be on the exams during lectures. He is very funny and offers one extra credit opportunity before each exam. I would take him again if I could!

I loved Dr. Lee! His lectures were great, although he got sidetracked some, he made sure to clearly state what he wants you to know. He hosted weekly review sessions, and extra before tests and is very accessible outside of class. During class he provided extra credit so you are encouraged to go-I never missed one just because I liked being there.

I took Bio 112 in the summer and it was brutal but he made the course as tolerable as possible. He cares a bunch about his students, offers a bunch of extra credit, and problem sets are easy 100s. He gets off topic every 5 seconds in class so it can be hard to focus, but he covers what is needed for the exam (for the most part). 10/10 recommend.

One of the best professors I've had at A&M! He is very accessible outside of class and holds many reviews (especially leading up to the exams). I also like how he organizes the course. The slides he goes through in class have everything you need to know. He's really funny too!

Dr. Lee was a great professor and went straight to the point in lecture, because he taught very well and kept you engaged. I learned a lot in this course and did well on exams, getting As and Bs. Only the lab portion brought my average down, but it's easy as long as you study.

If you are planning on being involved in the medical field in any way TAKE DR. LEE! Genuinely the best professor Ive had, he really cares about each of his students & makes the material palatable & entertaining. Tons of extra credit & he repeats himself purposefully for hints on exam questions (don't skip lectures) & gives credit back on exams q's.

Dr. Lee is a great professor!!! He repeats the topics he puts on the exams over and over, so it's very hard to be surprised when you open your exam. He also gives a ton of extra credit to the people that show up to his lecture. You will have to memorize a lot and his slides can be unorganized, but it's very easy to do well in his class.

Hilarious professor. His class was significantly harder than the other professors, however, he gave us the tools to succeed in his class. Difficult exams but extra credit. His final was very difficult and a little unfair, however if you attended every lecture the amount of bonus points made it to where you should have not needed to score well.

I love Dr.Lee, he's an amazing professor who really cares about his students. He is aware how difficult the class is, and pushes students to "redefine the word busy" and this mindset really helped me. His stories helped me recall concepts, but some can find this distracting. He definitely keeps you engaged. Extra credit is possible in lecture.

Dr. Lee was my favorite professor this semester. He's very engaging and explains everything in ways that I remembered. Several of his test questions are direct quotes from class, so go to class for those easy questions. His tests are hard, no doubt, but after the 2nd exam you know what's coming, and what to expect. Would absolutely take him again.

Dr. Lee has been one of my favorite professors at TAMU. Granted, I didn't enjoy BIOL112 that much, and I also didn't enjoy his hour and 15-minute lectures at 8 a.m., but I always showed up because it is so clear that Dr. Lee cares about his students and wants us to succeed. Outlines key information before exams and always has clear expectations.

Dr. Lee is a very funny guy, he makes the 8 am bearable. He tells you exactly what you need to know and focuses a lot on prepping for grad school pre-reqs. I am excited to have him in 319 next semester.

AMAZING!! Lectures are vital to the tests, though, so only take if you can make it to every class. Lee really cares and enjoys teaching and offers advice for med/ dental school. The material was difficult at times and there was A LOT of memorization required, but getting an A is defiantly double. Lots of extra credit too!

Dr. Lee is by far my favorite professor I've had so far. He makes class so fun and entertaining (really necessary for an 8 am lecture!) while really making sure you know the material. He gives a lot of review opportunities for exams and makes sure you really know what to expect. He's so passionate teaching and his students!

Dr. Lee is AWESOME literally the best professor I've ever had. He cares so deeply about our success and is so helpful with explaining tough concepts. Genuinely look forward to attending his lectures, he's hilarious! In the lecture part of 319, there's 3 tests and a cumulative final that are straightforward. The only hard part of this class is lab.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Lee is a good lecturer and is helpful when trying to understand the material, especially if you are pre-med. It's easy to make a passing grade in this class, however, it's not easy to make an A in this class. The way he formats his exams aren't clear and don't always include the material he tells you to study. I wouldn't take him again.

Dr. Lee is by far my favorite professor I've had at A&M. He genuinely cares about us learning the material and lectures are amazing. He is hilarious and ties the course material into his jokes sometimes which makes things so much easier. Also tells you what to focus studying on. Sometimes gets off track a little but it's never detrimental.

Do not take him if you want to spend a majority of the time figuring out what you need to know. Lectures and slides are extremely unorganized!!! He is focused on pre-med students and goes too much into depth. Lectures are boring but there is an occasional extra credit question.

Dr. Lee is a very reasonable professor. He gives a ton of extra credit opportunities, make sure to be at class on the days right before break! He makes sure to emphasize and repeat several times the things that will be on the test. Make sure to study, but the class is overall pretty easy.

Dr. Lee was an amazing prof for my first semester at A&M! He loves talking about sports and gets off topic easy but that's what made his lectures interesting. He goes through lecture pretty fast but as long as you show up to class, you'll receive extra credit. He holds review sessions before every exam and says exactly what will be on the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Lee over the summer for biology 112, and I really enjoyed it. I thought I would struggle, however, Dr. Lee made the class interesting and was clear about what was expected from his students. I definitely recommend Dr. Lee for your future classes, he truly gets and cares for his students.

Lee is an amazing professor but I took it at around 2:00 so I found it hard to focus. He is very generous with extra credit and gives hints at future questions on exams if you attend lecture. He is also very big on detail so MAKE SURE TO READ INSTRUCTIONS!

I thought this class was going to be way harder than it was. It is a lot of memorization rather than understanding concepts. Lecture wasn't mandatory, but I highly suggest going. Most questions on exams come from lecture, not just the slides. Also recommend attending his review sessions before exams, they don't take long at all.

Prof Lee teaches and structures his class as if everyone in the class is preparing to be a doctor which has upsides and downsides.  Best advice would be go to class, he's going to point out specific things in lecture and will usually tell you exactly what material to expect on the test.

I loved prof. Lee! He is very passionate about his students and subject matter. He tells you what will be on the exams during lectures and provides a lot of extra credit. He is so funny and keeps lectures interesting! As long as you study what he emphasizes in class you will be set! 10/10!!!

Great prof. Def take him again. Tells you exactly which topics that are on the exam. Went out of his way to have test review zooms on a Sunday. Very available and encourages you to see him. Gave a lot of extra credit. Cares about his students well-being and he's very funny. Attendance isn't mandatory, but need to go to watch powerpoint lectures.

Easy A class partially due to the professor. Took this as a 5-week summer class. Links content to human and veterinary medicine and likes to include humor. Very effective and entertaining lecturer who will go out of his way for exam reviews and office hours.

Lee is a great professor. If you plan to go into medicine, he links alot of the class to it. Exams are content heavy. Pay attention in lecture because he points out key points for exams. Check for details in PowerPoints for exams. Would take his class again.

Great person. Has an acquired sense of humor. Tests are reused every semester but he makes his own questions. Lab is super easy but lab exams suck. Just go to lecture to get the points!!! His one flaw is that his powerpoints are so long and extra and he truly does sound like a broken record. Gives super good advice and is rooting for us

He is an amazing professor. Engaging lectures, great teaching methods, and tests are not hard if you put in the work. Labs can be iffy depending on your TA. He is also very funny and has lots of pride in his teaching. He wants you to succeed, with lots of extra credit. IF YOU HAVE THE EGGS YOU HAVE THE POWER.

Such a great professor!! His lectures were engaging, and he clearly outlines the topics that will be on the test. You definitely have to study, but he offers a good amount of extra credit, and I thought it was pretty easy to get an A!

Extremely funny (bio dad jokes). Difficult exams but lectures, his slides, and him repeating the same stuff every day should do the trick. Very generous on extra credit (read the test instructions). Knowledgeable about the MCAT (so befriend him, premed students). Don't recommend cramming but it's doable. Let nights and weekends go your way!
This was one of the best profs that i have ever had. TAKE HIMMMMMM!

SUMMER CLASS: This class is very lecture heavy and the test have A LOT of roman numeral questions so that was a challenge. The class went very fast as we went through about 50-70 slides a day and it was hard to pay attention in class as he goes off topic a lot. But if you pay attention in class class, you can make an A in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is one of the best profs I've had at A&M. He's a valuable resource that you should use, especially if you're premed. His lecture style is conversational, so it might be hard to get used to, but he'll explicitly tell you what will be on the exam. He's kinda funny too, if you like dad humor.

Not much to say. This class should be an easy A if you go to lectures and pay attention. I've heard people say they can't and even saw people fall asleep in class but if you just pay attention you will do fine. Lab was a lot harder than lecture.
Chris lee is giggling to himself all class. He loves this stuff

Go to class, pay attention, and you will notice he tells you many things that are going to be on the test. Honestly, if you go to class this should be an easy A. Just go to class and note down everytime he mentions something is going to be on the test

Read the other low reviews, they are accurate.  One of the worst things is his lack of communication.  Often ghosted me on emails and did not show up to meetings I scheduled, and emailed me back a few days later after I went to his office in the flood.  His lectures are off topic, and way too fast.  He is a good resource, but not a good professor.

He is an amazing professor although his class is lecture heavy, he is an amazing listener and will sit down and chat with you. You do have to pay attention to understand his material but he goes over it multiple times and explains it well. He even gives you answers to his tests throughout lecture to help prepare you for what may be on his exam.
Hard to keep up with his lectures

Nice guy but makes the class unnecessarily hard which is fine if you are looking to go into med school but I just figured I should warn everyone on here to let them know that he is not for everyone. I had a hard time in his class.
Nice guy but very unorganized. takimg him at 8 am was a mistake

One of my favorite professors at A&M. It is a hard class, especially because of lab, but Lee gives you a lot of hints as to what will be on his tests, and he writes the lab practical so he can give you hints about that too. Absolutely horrible. Worst class of College so far. Do not learn anything in there. reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lee is a great guy but kinda rambles in lectures. He tells you what material will be covered on the test and is clear on that but the test is kinda abstract application. In my top 3 profs at TAMU. Excellent lecturer, really cares, interesting material. One of my top classes at TAMU too. Dr. Lee made me love bio again (bio major)

This class requires a lot of work, especially with lab. That being said, Lee understands the class is hard and offers weekly reviews for lab and lecture. He really wants students to succeed. I didn't think class helped much for the exams. Get the A-Plus reviews and you'll be fine. He's cool, but he says the same jokes and quotes over, and over, and over again. Take advantage of every extra credit opportunity.

Dr. Lee is an amazing professor and is super funny! He takes the time to answer any and all questions students have in and outside of class. Lee is an amazing prof. Truly cares about biology and his students. His tests weren't terrible but you have to study really hard for them because they can be a little detailed. READ the BOOK. the only hard part about his class was the lab. It definitely depends on what ta you have because the quizzes can be SOOO hard. The labs themselves were easy.

Dr. Lee taught a very difficult course and made it a lot easier and more fun. He helps out with lab immensely which is probably the hardest part of the course. One of the best to take for BIOL 112. He breaks it down super easy and he gives you heads up on what to expect for lab that week. Read the book for supplemental info, but other than that all the test material comes from his lectures.

Lee is an alright professor. He will basically just go over a powerpoint that is pulled directly from the book (so read your book!), and make some comments about the text. Dr. Lee was a great professor. At first it was a little confusing to discern what to study and what to take down during his lecture. He's super helpful and willing to talk to you.

reviews.comment: If you can, take Professor Lee. His lectures are always fun even at 8 a.m and he will tell you what material will be on the exam. Reading the text book before lecture is very helpful because that is what he lectures and has his notes over. Take advantage of a lot of his extra credit points, max 5 or 6 points! Practice questions are great to study.

Clear about his expectations for you in this class. He is happy to help if you want it. He gives bonus opportunities and take advantage of them. Reading the textbook is major if you want to understand what he talks about and extra tutoring is a great idea. Lab is so much worse than lecture and may be the only reason it is difficult.

Dr. Lee's lectures were always hilarious and told you most everything you needed to know for the test. You do have to read the chapters from the book. He always hinted at what specific questions would be on the test and he provided a lot of practice questions for studying. It is a difficult class, but it is supposed to be and he makes it fun!
The best bio prof for 112 and its not even close, he is very straight forward and does not try to trick his students. Your grade will reflect your effort.

Very clear on his expectations, the lectures are interesting and the exams are fair. Great professor if you actually want to learn things, he is not an easy A. By the way the lab is really challenging.

Dr. Lee is an awesome professor. Going to class and actually paying attention helps so much. Just make sure you study your notes and read over the textbook chapters and you should have no problem getting a good grade (as long as you put in the effort). He tries to help out his students as much as he can. I would definitely recommend taking him.

I had Chris Lee for Biol 112 and I loved it. He kept it interesting considering it was an 8am. Went to class everyday and a plus tutoring for tests and ended up with a B in the class. Test aren't to terrible, just study. Make sure you read the directions!!! The second test was the hardest for me.

I was nervous coming into my 1st semester of college, but Lee was great at making the transition easy. Show up to class. He often gives bonus opportunities and gives questions that could possibly show up on the exams (& they usually do). You have to read the textbook cause he uses some info from it. The class requires effort, but an A is possible.

Dr. Lee was really hard. He says a lot of things in class that do not pertain to biology at all and it is very confusing. If you actually want to learn biology, take Dr. Lee. His class is tough and he really makes you work for your grade. This guy will marry you off with the textbook because OML his lectures are intense. But even with his in depth explanations he will still test you over small details in the book. Suited to teach different learning types,  genuinely cares about his students grasping  the material,  he went the extra mile to give us links the resources like YouTube videos and other online materials, organized and user friendly course e campus page, study material all in one place. lighthearted nature, engaging lectures
I did not enjoy this class whatsoever. Lee was very vague about what he expected from his students and it was nearly impossible to pass.

Dr. Lee is the best teacher i've ever had. He is very tough and makes you work for an A but you will learn a lot and he is more then willing to help you. Wonderful, if you need bio and want an amazing professor but don't mind working for it pick Lee!

Dr. Lee is probably one of the best professors I have had. He is a tough teacher but everyone can get through it you just have to be committed. I recommend him to anyone planning on taking Biol 111. He is truly amazing.
